acceptance_policy.scope: Synthetic engineering compatibility only; no scientific release or accuracy claim
acceptance_policy.decision_acceptance: Zero changes versus BOTH PyTorch FP32 and ONNX FP32 in NLI maxima/ties, review flags/reasons, abstention and unavailable states
acceptance_policy.contract_acceptance: Exact token IDs/masks, evidence/offsets, deterministic labels, modality/identity gates, budgets and closed research gates
acceptance_policy.numerical_acceptance: Finite logits and valid normalized probabilities required. Logit/probability drift is descriptive; no FP32 numerical tolerances are applied to INT8 and no numerical equivalence is claimed
acceptance_policy.justification: INT8 is lossy. Exact decisions test compatibility with the unchanged review controller; arbitrary relaxed probability thresholds would not establish that compatibility
acceptance_policy.failure_action: Retain the single candidate as experimental; report every disagreement; do not tune rules, thresholds or quantization settings to force parity

quantization.nodes: Explicit allowlist: existing MatMul nodes with a constant FLOAT rank-2 weight as input B
quantization.other_operators: Excluded; dynamic attention MatMuls and classifier Gemm nodes remain unquantized

limitations: Single predeclared quantization setting; not tuned after observing output disagreements.
INT8 numerical drift is descriptive; FP32 numerical tolerances were not relaxed or applied to INT8.
Exact decision parity failed; this candidate remains experimental and must not replace either FP32 runtime.
Only 36 existing constant-weight MatMul nodes quantized; embeddings and every excluded tensor data remain unchanged.
ORT implicit classifier Gemm normalization was reversed using source nodes/tensors; source output declarations restored.
Two CPU threads, 36 matched short synthetic calls per backend, three hypothesis pairs per call, one excluded warm-up, fresh sequential processes.
Warm file cache possible; loading excludes imports. Memory is whole-process Windows resident/committed peaks, including identical dependency imports.
The resource-budget check replays already measured real scores; it does not claim 512 additional native forwards.
All disagreement records below include both FP32 baselines; counts therefore include paired records.
No research data, training, calibration, quantization of embeddings, browser deployment or scientific release.
